title: The Burden That Brought Healing
intro: A soul tested beyond measure was stripped of comfort, of companions, and of bodily strength. Isolated in deep affliction, this servant of Allah turned only toward the Divine. Through unwavering patience and heartfelt prayer, a tide of mercy arrived that surpassed all expectation. Who is this figure whose devotion opened a door of restoration?
clues: I was a favored servant of Allah, enjoying abundance, a flourishing household, and good health in my days.
Then a trial descended: wealth departed, loved ones departed, and my own flesh was struck with grave affliction.
Those near to me could not endure my condition, and I was left isolated, my body wracked with suffering.
I called upon my Lord, declaring that Satan had touched me with exhaustion and punishment.
The response came — a command to strike the ground with my foot, and from it gushed forth cool water for healing.
My Lord removed the hardship entirely and restored to me my family, multiplied, as a sign of mercy for those who reflect.
